style.styleTitle: Premier Decorations Ltd 6ft Lit White Chasing Spiral Pyramid Tree
style.toneOfVoice: Create an impressive illuminated display with this 1.8 m FlexiBrights® White Chasing Spiral Pyramid Tree. The stylish design is enhanced by 752 white and warm white mix LEDs and features 15 multi action effects, including steady on, flowing effects, exploding, waves, jump light, fade, sequential, chasing and star chasing. Complete with a 5 m lead cable and a convenient timer function with 8 hours on followed by 16 hours off, it is easy to enjoy your display each day. Perfect for adding a striking finishing touch to Christmas displays, this illuminated spiral pyramid tree creates an eye-catching focal point wherever it is placed.
